topic: Making a tax-refund allocation plan vs blowing the windfall (Everett vs Romy)

scenes.narration: The average tax refund lands near three thousand dollars every single spring. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a giant refund check, comic burst banner reads THREE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Everett and Romy both get a three thousand dollar refund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man everett and woman romy in gym gear holding refund checks stamped THREE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each sees that lump sum hit the same April week.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, everett and romy checking phones on a gym bench, a calendar labeled APRIL REFUND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Everett treats the whole refund like surprise free party money.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, everett tossing cash in the air on a gym mat, a banner reads FREE MONEY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He blows it on gadgets, dinners, and a quick trip.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, everett surrounded by gadgets and a suitcase near a gym locker, comic banner reads SPLURGE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Romy splits her refund using a simple written allocation plan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, romy on a gym mat sketching a pie chart labeled REFUND PLAN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Half kills her debt, forty percent saves, ten percent fun.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, romy pointing at a gym wall pie chart stamped DEBT SAVE FUN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She still enjoys three hundred guilt-free dollars just for herself.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, romy smiling with a small cash envelope near a gym bench stamped THREE HUNDRED FUN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One month later Everett's entire refund is completely gone already.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked everett on a gym bench holding an empty wallet stamped ALL GONE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Romy erased fifteen hundred in debt and boosted her savings.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, romy crossing out a debt slip in the gym stamped FIFTEEN HUNDRED PAID, a rising savings jar beside her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That one refund permanently improved her entire financial picture forever.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, romy flexing before a gym wall chart with a rising line labeled STRONGER FINANCES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Give every refund dollar a job before it even arrives. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle in the gym holding a clipboard reading REFUND PLAN, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
